title: 25. 물에선 조심조심, 어른이랑!
titleT: 25. Be Careful in the Water, Always with a Grown-up!

pages.ko: 무더운 여름, 호리가 아빠랑 수영장에 왔어요. 파란 물이 시원해 보였지요. "우와, 빨리 들어가고 싶다!"
pages.t: On a hot summer day, Hori came to the pool with Dad. The blue water looked so refreshing. "Wow, I want to jump in right now!"

pages.ko: 신난 호리가 물로 첨벙 뛰어들려 했어요. 그때 아빠가 호리를 잡았지요. "잠깐! 준비운동도 하고, 안전 준비부터 하자."
pages.t: Excited, Hori was about to leap splash into the water. Just then, Dad caught him. "Wait! Let's warm up first and get ready safely."

pages.ko: 먼저 준비운동을 했어요. 팔 쭉, 다리 쭉, 목도 빙글. 그리고 호리는 노란 구명조끼를 입었지요. "이제 안전 준비 끝!"
pages.t: First, they did warm-up exercises. Arms stretched out, legs stretched out, neck rolled around. Then Hori put on a yellow life vest. "Safety gear on, all ready now!"

pages.ko: "물에 들어갈 땐 발부터 천천히." 아빠가 알려 줬어요. 호리는 계단으로 발부터 살살 들어갔지요. "어, 시원해!"
pages.t: "When you enter the water, go in feet first, slowly." Dad showed him how. Hori went down the steps, easing his feet in gently. "Ooh, it's cool!"

pages.ko: 아빠 손을 꼭 잡고 물속에서 첨벙첨벙. "어른이랑 같이 있으니까 하나도 안 무섭고 재밌어!"
pages.t: Holding Dad's hand tightly, he splashed around in the water. "With a grown-up right here, it isn't scary at all — it's fun!"

pages.ko: 호리는 아빠와 발차기 연습도 했어요. 첨벙첨벙 물장구를 치니 앞으로 쑥! "내가 나아간다!" 그 순간 꼬리가 무지개로 반짝— 부릉부릉! 물에선 조심조심, 어른이랑!
pages.t: Hori practiced kicking with Dad too. Splashing his feet, he shot forward! "I'm moving forward!" At that moment, his tail sparkled in rainbow colors— vroom vroom! Be careful in the water, always with a grown-up!

pages.ko: "안전하게 노니까 훨씬 재밌어!" 호리는 아빠와 신나게 물놀이를 즐겼어요.
pages.t: "Playing safely makes it so much more fun!" Hori enjoyed splashing around happily with Dad.

pages.ko: "준비운동 하고, 구명조끼 입고, 어른이랑 함께!" 호리는 물놀이 규칙을 또박또박 외웠어요.
pages.t: "Warm up, wear a life vest, and stay with a grown-up!" Hori recited the water-safety rules clearly.

pages.ko: 이제 호리는 물놀이를 할 때 절대 혼자 뛰어들지 않아요. 준비운동을 하고, 어른과 함께 조심조심 놀지요. 꼬리가 또 부릉! 물에선 조심조심, 어른이랑!
pages.t: Now Hori never jumps into the water alone. He warms up first and plays carefully together with a grown-up. His tail went vroom again! Be careful in the water, always with a grown-up!

pages.ko: 아빠가 호리를 번쩍 안아 올렸어요. "우리 호리, 안전 박사네!" 물놀이는 준비하고 어른과 함께 해야 안전하다는 걸, 호리는 이제 알아요. 물에선 조심조심, 어른이랑!
pages.t: Dad scooped Hori up in his arms. "Our Hori is a safety expert!" Hori now knows that playing in the water is safe only when you prepare and stay with a grown-up. Be careful in the water, always with a grown-up!

overview.ko: 물이 신나 혼자 뛰어들려던 호리가 준비운동·구명조끼·어른 동반 등 물놀이 안전 규칙을 배우는 안전 동화입니다.
overview.t: This is a safety story about Hori, who was so excited about the water that he wanted to jump in alone, learning water-safety rules like warming up, wearing a life vest, and staying with a grown-up.

lessons.t: Play in the water together with a grown-up.

readingTips.t: Read the refrain 'Be careful in the water' clearly.

readingTips.ko: 물놀이 전에 규칙을 함께 정해 보세요.
readingTips.t: Try setting water-safety rules together before playing in water.
